evidence_summary: Replay capture on POST /v2/vectordb/collections/list shows non-integer Request-Timeout header values (float 3.5, string abc) accepted with http=200/code=0, and integer control 10 also 200/code=0 — illegal values silently accepted per same-version contract milvus_type_request_timeout_001.
rationale: Contract (doc-archaeology, evidence_tier=explicit) asserts Request-Timeout must match ^[0-9]+$ with non-integer rejected, yet both invalid variants were silently ignored and the request succeeded; this is a clear, doubly-reproduced Type1 illegal-success contract violation with a control, satisfying the high-evidence path (successful reproduction + clear contract violation signal) under semantic matching of the replay-capture log.
